Khong dinh gi den nghien cuu; 12 viec dot CPU thuan, moi viec 90 giay.
Cai can nhin la dong `~ HH:MM:SS | san sang N | CPU xx% ...` in moi ~2 phut.
DAT khi: CPU on dinh trong 78-92%, va so viec dang chay KHONG leo len 12.
Neu CPU cham 100% thi ha `nang_lan.CPU` trong config/qwen.json; neu no dung o
60% thi nang len. Con so 2,0 loi/viec la UOC luong chong vot trong 45 giay dau,
sau do phep do thay the - nen chi anh huong luc phong dau tien.
